title: Understanding LLMs
lead: How does a short travel request become a weekend itinerary?

sections.title: Start with a weekend away
sections.body:
You are spending two days in Hangzhou with an older family member and want short walks. Send those requirements to a model and it can draft an itinerary.
Other inputs could be customer emails, meeting notes, or product reviews, producing reply drafts, summaries, or classifications.

sections.title: What is a large language model?
sections.body:
An LLM generates output from the context it receives. Your application prepares the information it can use and decides what to do with the result.
Output may be text, structured data, or a tool-call request, depending on the model and API.

sections.title: A convincing plan still needs checking
sections.body:
A model may recommend a closed restaurant or put distant attractions next to each other. Fluent writing does not establish factual accuracy.
Current opening hours require reliable fresh information or lookup capabilities. A generated lookup request still needs code to execute it.

note: Add “traveling with a family member who has limited mobility.” Check whether the route actually reduces walking rather than simply repeating the requirement.
